item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi dpung rtsod pa bzlog pa'i 'khor lo g.yung drung gsang ba'i las gzhung
item.coloph: yang gsang sku yi brnag pa khro bo rtsod pa bzlog pa g.yung drung gsang ba'i las gzhung zhes bya ba/ ston pa ye gshen gtsug phud kyi lung don rgyud lung man ngag bcud du dril ba/ bsnyen sgrab las kyi go rim du bstan pa rdzogs so/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs kyi brnag pa/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi thugs bcud/ gsang ba sngags kyi rgyal po 'di las rgyas bsdus rnam pa gsum gyis gtan la dbab (phab) ste/ rgyas pa lha gshen yongs su dag pa yis/ don rgyud rgyas pa'i 'phrin las kyi skor du gsungs te/ steng lha yi yul du gtan la dbab (phab) pa'o/ bsdus paklu grub ye shes snying po'i man ngag sgron ma gsang thus kyi bskor (skor) du gsungs nas/ 'og klu yul du gtan la phabs so (phab bo)/ 'bring po rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs kyis/ lung don 'bring po sor bzhags kyi skor du gsungs nas/ bar mi yul du gtan la phab ste/ gshen nam mkha'i snang ba mdog can la brgyud do/ de nas gdung rabs rim par brgyud nas/ bla chen po dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) spel zhing bsgyar ro/ des stang dmu tsha gyer med la brgyud do/ des las ldan sprul pa'i sku/ dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen la brgyud cing / bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug sgrub brtson gyis spyod yul lo/ g.yung drung gsang ba'i las gzhung rdzogs so/ u ya/ ag thaM/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
